rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis proposes adding TiC nanoparticles, whereas the paper varied vanadium content in W–Ta alloys; these are fundamentally different kinds of interventions.
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis specifies 500–1000°C and up to 100 dpa, while the paper used 1073 K irradiation to ~20 dpa with 1 MeV Kr ions; the temperature range overlaps but the dose, ion species, and specific conditions differ.
rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis invokes TiC nanoparticles as defect sinks, whereas the paper's mechanism relies on V-induced changes in defect mobility, recombination, and chemical short-range order; these are different mechanistic classes.
rationale.outcome_agreement: The hypothesis predicts a 20% increase in radiation tolerance and 10% improved ductility, while the paper measured void size/density and segregation; the predicted property and direction are not aligned with the paper's actual result.
